Title: Complete a purchase using only the keyboard
Preconditions: Customer account; one product in stock
Steps: 1. Open the home page. 2. Using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Space, add a product to the cart. 3. Reach the cart and check out.
Expected result: Every control is reachable in a logical order; focus is always visible; no keyboard trap; the order is created.

Title: Screen reader announces a login error
Expected result: The error is announced without moving focus manually, and the form fields have spoken names.

Title: Double-clicking Checkout does not create two orders
Preconditions: Customer with one item in the cart
Steps: 1. Open the cart. 2. Double-click Checkout quickly. 3. Open My Orders and check stock.
Expected result: Exactly one order exists and stock was reduced once.

Title: Cart survives a reload and is shared by two tabs
Steps: 1. Add an item. 2. Reload. 3. Open the shop in a second tab and add another item. 4. Check both tabs after reload.
Expected result: The cart keeps its items after reload; the second tab shows the same cart after reload.

Title: Product list is usable at phone width (375 px)
Steps: 1. Open the home page. 2. Use search, category, sort and price slider. 3. Open a product.
Expected result: No horizontal scrolling; controls are not overlapped; text is readable; buttons are large enough to tap.

Title: Script in a review comment is shown as text
Steps: 1. Post a review with the comment . 2. Reload the product page and open it as another user.
Expected result: The text is shown literally; no alert runs.

Title: Review with very long text, emoji and line breaks
Steps: 1. Post a review with 5,000 characters, then one with emoji and line breaks.
Expected result: The review is stored and displayed without breaking the layout, or a clear limit message is shown.

Title: Back button after checkout
Steps: 1. Check out. 2. Press the browser Back button.
Expected result: The cart is empty; no second order can be created from the old page.

Title: Quantity field edge values in the UI
Steps: 1. On a product page enter 0, -1, 1.5, 999999 and an empty value, then Add to Cart.
Expected result: Invalid values are refused or corrected; the cart never holds a negative or fractional quantity.

Title: Session after logout and Back button
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Sign out. 3. Press Back and try to open My Orders.
Expected result: Protected pages redirect to login; no private data is shown from the browser cache.

Title: Password policy exploration
Steps: 1. Register with the passwords a, 12345, and a 72 and 73 character password.
Expected result: Record what is accepted. Known gap: there is no strength policy. Decide with the product owner what the rule should be.

Title: Email letter case at registration and login
Steps: 1. Register A@example.com. 2. Register a@example.com. 3. Log in with a@example.com.
Expected result: Record the behaviour. Known gap: emails are not normalised, so the two are different accounts.

Title: Rounding of totals with decimal prices
Steps: 1. Add 3 x 19.99 and 3 x 0.10 to the cart. 2. Compare the cart total with the order total in My Orders.
Expected result: Both show 59.97 and 0.30 summed correctly; cart and order totals are identical.

Title: Very long or markup-containing product name (admin)
Steps: 1. Create a product with a 300 character name and another named bold. 2. View them in the catalogue and the dashboard.
Expected result: The layout holds; markup is shown as text; or a length limit is enforced with a clear message.
